tools.name: check_llm_brand_prompt
tools.description: Execute a real-time buying-intent prompt on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, or Gemini and inspect whether a target brand is mentioned, its 1-based recommendation rank, sentiment, visibility score (0–100), excerpt, and cited URLs. Cost: 50 Credits ($0.005, 24h cached; 0 Credits on error).

tools.name: compare_competitor_share_of_voice
tools.description: Compare 2 to 8 competing brands head-to-head on a single LLM prompt across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, or Gemini. Returns Share-of-Voice %, mention counts, 1-based ranking positions, sentiment, and overall category winner. Cost: 50 Credits ($0.005, 24h cached).

tools.name: check_google_ai_overview
tools.description: Query live Google AI Mode / AI Overview results for any keyword and location, returning the generative summary markdown, all cited source URLs & domains, and whether your brand is cited and at which reference positions. Cost: 80 Credits ($0.008, 24h cached).

tools.name: get_domain_llm_mentions
tools.description: Retrieve aggregated domain-level LLM mention totals, AI search volume, impressions, citation share %, platform breakdown, and top cited URLs. Pre-cached top 50 tech benchmark domains (stripe.com, vercel.com, linear.app, supabase.com, etc.) cost 50 Credits on any tier; uncached live custom domains re

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_llm_brand_prompt, check_google_ai_overview, get_domain_llm_mentions · Public sink: compare_competitor_share_of_voice, get_domain_llm_mentions · Destructive: check_llm_brand_prompt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_llm_brand_prompt, check_google_ai_overview, get_domain_llm_mentions · Public sink: compare_competitor_share_of_voice, get_domain_llm_mentions · Destructive: check_llm_brand_prompt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
